title: Design System: Señas a Voces Academy

index-title.purpose: The Índice page h2 only. Petroleum (fg in dark mode).

display.purpose: Cover h1 only. Petroleum, with the second line set as a cyan block.

statement.purpose: The scroll-revealed manifesto and the closing quote on the band. Max 18 to 22ch.

headline.purpose: The h2 chapter title of each sheet. Petroleum on cream, max 760px. The contact h2 runs at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 60px).

index-entry.purpose: Chapter rows on the Índice page. fg, cyan on hover, folio at 0.7em muted tabular.

subtitle.purpose: Device captions and audience terms (24px), creator names (clamp 24 to 28px), milestone labels (19px chip step).

subtitle-sm.purpose: Glove step titles and press headlines (22px, 1.18 leading on clippings).

body-lead.purpose: Sheet intros under the headline. Muted, max 56ch.

body.purpose: Running copy in muted, 36 to 48ch measures. The base is 16px at 1.6.

body-sm.purpose: Creator bios, milestone detail lines, the interpreter note. 15px at 1.5 to 1.6.

label.purpose: Buttons, header controls, status lines, text links. Sentence case, never tracked uppercase.

caption.purpose: Figure captions, roles, press outlets, reach labels. The proof strip uses 14px bold at 80% fg.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Every sheet after the cover. Cast upward onto the sheet it covers.

shadows.name: hanging-tab
shadows.purpose: Both hanging tabs at the top edge.

shadows.name: chapter-tab-active
shadows.purpose: The petroleum tab of the current chapter on the right-edge rail.

shadows.name: object-on-paper
shadows.purpose: Press clippings. Logo plaques use 0 14px 30px -18px; the glove mat uses 0 2px 4px / 0.05, 0 24px 48px -28px / 0.35.

shadows.name: phone
shadows.purpose: The phone chassis. The 3D laptop carries no drop shadow; its depth is its geometry.

shadows.name: amber-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons at rest. Hover: 0 10px 22px -8px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.8).

shadows.name: card-on-band
shadows.purpose: The contact form card on the petroleum band.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: UI state transitions at 200 to 300ms (buttons, links, fields).

motion.name: ease-rail
motion.purpose: Chapter tab slide and color at 300ms; the contact submit lift at 200ms.

motion.name: index-slide
motion.purpose: The Índice dialog slides down over the stack. Reduced motion: no transition.

motion.name: inertial-scroll
motion.value: Lenis duration 1.1s, easing 1 - (1 - t)^4; chapter jumps scrollTo 1.4s
motion.purpose: Page scroll and chapter jumps via the sheet-start resolver. Not started under reduced motion; jumps are instant.

motion.name: sheet-recede
motion.purpose: A sheet sticks at min(0, viewport height − sheet height) while the next one covers it. Progress runs from the next sheet's top entering the viewport to it reaching the top. Reduced motion: stacks without scale or dim.

motion.name: backdrop-drift
motion.value: circle y 0 -> -60 to -260px across the viewport
motion.purpose: Three circles per sheet at separate rates. Reduced motion: still.

motion.name: cover-depth
motion.value: copy -50px, lead photo -90 / block -40, second photo -170 / block -110; pointer spring stiffness 80 damping 18, far x10, near x-18
motion.purpose: Cover layers drift at separate rates while it is covered. The pointer layer runs on fine pointers only.

motion.name: portrait-block-trail
motion.purpose: A creator's offset block trails its photo. Reduced motion: 0.

motion.name: depth-image
motion.purpose: Photos drift inside 20px frames. Reduced motion: held at -6.5%.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.purpose: Manifesto statement. Reduced motion: full ink. The screen reader reads the intact sentence.

motion.name: trajectory-draw
motion.value: pathLength scrubbed from start 75% to end 92%, spring stiffness 120 damping 30; pen point at getPointAtLength(total x drawn)
motion.purpose: A solid petroleum stroke draws over the dashed path with a cyan pen at its tip. Reduced motion: fully drawn, no pen.

motion.name: settle-once
motion.value: milestone media: spring 0.7s bounce 0.25 from scale 0.86, rotate ±5deg, y 22px; press cards: spring 0.8s bounce 0.2 from y 36px, rotate ±1.5deg, 60ms stagger per row
motion.purpose: Objects on the paper settle once on first view, transform only, never opacity. Reduced motion: at rest.

motion.name: laptop-open
motion.value: lid rotateX -88deg -> 4deg over progress 0.05 -> 0.6; device rotateY ±26 -> ±4deg, rotateX -34 -> -13deg, scale 0.82 -> 1; perspective 2200px
motion.purpose: Lesson laptop scrubbed from start 62% to center 48%; secondary laptops from start 78% to center 52%, turning from opposite sides. Reduced motion: progress pinned at 1.

motion.name: phone-swing
motion.value: x 55% -> 0, rotateY -48 -> -14deg, rotateZ 10 -> 2deg over stage 0.45 -> 1; opacity 0 -> 1 over 0.4 -> 0.6; perspective 1200px
motion.purpose: The phone swings in on the lesson laptop's progress. Reduced motion: in place.

narrative.northStar: The Portfolio That Turns Its Own Pages
narrative.overview:
The site is the team's evidence portfolio, bound and paged. Every chapter is a cream sheet (22px corners) lying on a deeper sand desk. A sheet scrolls normally until its bottom edge reaches the viewport, then sticks there and recedes slightly as the next sheet slides over it. Depth comes from paper stacking and scroll-linked parallax: behind each sheet's copy, three soft solid circles in petroleum, amber and cyan drift at their own rates. The portfolio cover's concentric cyan wave lines sit in two opposite corners of every sheet. That is how the brand repeats from page to page. The portfolio is navigated the way a binder is: cream tabs hang from the top edge, divider tabs run down the right edge, and an "Índice" page slides down over the stack.

Petroleum carries the voice: League Spartan titles, set heavy and tight. Cyan appears at display size, in the wave lines and as the data and trajectory marks, including the pen point that draws the trajectory. Amber is reserved for actions and small markers. Body text is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a face built for legibility, because the audience includes deaf and hard-of-hearing readers and accessibility-focused institutions. Imagery is real: the four creators photographed under colored light, each on an offset block in their own color, the team's own drawing of the glove, and real platform recordings playing on a laptop built in true CSS 3D that opens its lid as you arrive.

The density is editorial. Wide sheets carry generous vertical breaks between chapters (up to 160px). Any section can hold asymmetric two-column compositions. The deliberate dark moments are the petroleum contact sheet that closes the stack, one band-colored featured quote and the band-colored reach card in the press grid.
keyCharacteristics: Paged sheets with 22px corners on a sand desk. Each sheet sticks at its bottom edge and recedes to 0.94 scale, dimming toward the desk, as the next sheet covers it.
Binder navigation: hanging cream tabs at the top edge, vertical divider tabs on the right edge with the current chapter in petroleum, and a full "Índice" page with dotted leaders and folio numbers.
Petroleum League Spartan display type (700, -0.02em, line-height 0.92 to 1.02). Cyan is used only for the second line of the cover headline and for marks.
Amber pill actions with a warm amber glow. Amber dots mark status and proof.
Concentric cyan wave lines in opposite sheet corners at 45% and 35% opacity, over three drifting backdrop circles at 6 to 12% opacity.
Creator portraits sit on per-person colored offset blocks, and the block drifts on a different parallax rate from the photo.

Motion is scroll-linked depth first: Lenis inertial scroll, parallax, a word reveal, the trajectory drawing itself with a pen point, and a 3D laptop opening and turning to face the reader. Objects placed on the paper may settle once on first view, by transform only. When reduced motion is on, all of it goes still and the stacking layout stays.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Gray Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a warm sand/cream or a petroleum-tinted ink. Even the receding-sheet dim and the "Índice" backdrop are the desk color (up to 55% and 70%), never black or gray. Device hardware (chassis, silver deck, keys) is the one exception, because it depicts a real object.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Solid amber fills only things you can press, plus tiny dots that mark status or proof. It never fills a card or a band. The only other amber is the 10 to 12% backdrop circle, which is atmosphere, not a surface.

rules.name: The No-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case in bold Atkinson. The system has no tracked-out uppercase small labels and no kickers above titles. A sheet's title is the first thing on the sheet.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Display-Size Rule
rules.body: Cyan text appears only at display, figure or index-entry size (24px and up). Running text stays in fg or muted.

rules.name: The Recede, Don't Fade Rule
rules.body: A covered sheet scales from 1 to 0.94 (origin at the bottom center) while a desk-colored overlay rises from 0 to 0.55. Sections, headings, copy and cards never fade in or out on entrance.

rules.name: The Settle, Never Hide Rule
rules.body: An object placed on the paper (milestone media, the press grid) may settle once, the first time it is seen: a spring on scale, rotation and y only, never opacity. It is fully visible from first paint, it never replays, and under reduced motion it renders at rest.

rules.name: The Shadow Points Up Rule
rules.body: Sheet shadows use a negative y offset because the newer page lies on top. Never drop a sheet shadow downward.

dos: Do build every new chapter as a sheet: 22px corners, the upward sheet-edge shadow, a backdrop-circle layout different from its neighbors, wave lines in opposite corners, and a headline-plus-intro header.
Do register every new chapter in the chapter list so it gets a divider tab and an "Índice" entry, and route its in-page links through the sheet-start resolver rather than native anchors.
Do set titles in petroleum League Spartan 700 at -0.02em. Keep running text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, at 17px with 1.65 leading, in muted, within 36 to 56ch.
Do fill actions with amber and amber-ink in full pills that are at least 48px tall (44px in the header), and pair a primary button with an underlined text link rather than a second filled button.
Do express depth through scroll-linked motion (stacking, parallax, drawn paths and the 3D laptop), and give every motion value a reduced-motion value of 0 or its resting state.
Do show real people, real devices, real platform recordings and the team's own drawings, shown whole. Put creators on their own tone's offset block.
Do tint shadows with petroleum and keep the neutrals warm sand and cream.
donts: Don't add fade-up or slide-in entrance animations to sections, headings or copy. The only entry-triggered motion is the once-only transform settle of objects placed on the paper (milestone media, press cards), and it never touches opacity.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a sheet title, or use tracked uppercase small labels.
Don't set body copy or small labels in cyan. It reaches only large-text contrast on cream.
Don't fill cards, bands or large areas with solid amber.
